notes.title: V. 0.12.0 is released! Have you seen my new store?
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

The last update arrived just before Christmas, and time sure does fly. It's already mid February! However we didn't have a long vacation, but have instead been working hard on bringing you a big update featuring a lot of improvements to the game. But let me go into the specifics of it.[/b]


[h2]--- Store fronts ---[/h2]

Now that I have the assistance of a graphics artist the graphics of the game will get a lot more attention than before. One of the largest areas where this already came to show, is the rework of the store fronts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/983395166eef6e9f636daa5eabe3bc1e1183b7f8.png[/img]

So instead of having to deal with the simple facade, there is now a wide variety of store fronts to select from. All of them customizable in various ways, to allow you give your stores an even more unique look. In the future even more customizablility will most likely be added to these store fronts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/56df017e530808b4981679930e5f22ca4cac54cd.png[/img]


[h2]--- Showcasing ---[/h2]

However these store fronts have been added for other reasons than just looking good. Almost every store uses the possibility of adding focus to various articles by showcasing them in their windows.
This is also possible now, as each store front have several areas where you can showcase a specific article. 
This will add more hype to articles, making the customers want to buy them even more. In this way you can better influence the customers to buy what you want them to.
But also remember to change your window once in a while, as the customers at some point will have seen and purchased that article making it less effective over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/402583d59b9d03ffb4bdc5e1b1e72fd71562a9f5.png[/img]


[h2]--- Build system ---[/h2]

One of the first things that was added to the game, was the system that built the floors, walls and the store itself from various data. And that system has just been built on and built on until now. However as that system was built in the early phase, where I knew a lot less than I do now, that system had a lot of limitations. 
So to be able to do some things I wanted to add, this system needed to be completely rewritten, which has taken quite some time.

But why was this actually done?

Well first of all to support the new store fronts of varying sizes, which can also be moved around.
But also to allow for something a lot of you has asked for, for some time now. That is placing walls wherever you would like. 
So now you can add walls and split up your sales areas in smaller compartments if you would like to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3135b2b2c5510190111b0e7763cb1bf585a0f905.png[/img]

And since the UI of that menu also needed an upgrade as many found it difficult to use, I gave it a complete overhaul also, making it lot easier to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/cc7e986b1b9e9785414a2460e639e4eee934cecc.png[/img]

This also now allows for you to change floors and walls in stores you can't expand, so you still have some possibilities in that regard.


[h2]--- Other graphics upgrades ---[/h2]
Since the looks of the store recieved this upgrade, I decided to focus on upgraded more areas such that the looks of the store would change completely 

[h3]--- New ceiling ---[/h3]
First of all the ceiling of the store has been upgraded to a much better look, as well as allowing you to select its color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7e065276c43dc01a4a110e5c78068f185aff3aa8.png[/img]

[h3]--- New walls & floors ---[/h3]
Also there has been a large addition to the selection of floors and walls you can select from to customize the looks of your store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/8e4ba9c880cc3eaa303ec56400e7a0a104d84b5f.jpg[/img]


[h2]--- Smaller implementations ---[/h2]

There have also been made some smaller changes to other areas of the game

[b]- Selection of floor plans in campaign mode[/b]
The biggest flaw of the old build system, was that it didn't support transitions of floor plans in an easy way between being in and out of the store. With this fixed, you can now select between various floor plans before you buy or rent a store in the campaign mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/dca42b2ab3f7c0b63d27f541e1a49d3038ec7d5d.png[/img]

[b]- Single store category selections[/b]
Before you start a single store game you are asked which categories you wish to sell. 
As having more articles requires more performance from your computer, I hope the possibility of selecting more articles will help those of you who have trouble running the Single Store mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f9755afea41ebaafd5652b17ddd47d5e8c6b6676.png[/img]

[b]- Outer materials[/b]
As a minor preparation to give the areas your stores lie in various looks, the outer wall of the building you reside in will now have a random material, instead of only having the same dark gray color for all buildings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f8d7cc23d1c3c8fdcb1e812c728e3471bae3abfc.png[/img]

There are plans of adding unique environments for all major areas in campaign mode, however this is quite a task, so it is held off for a bit.

[b]- Bigger area[/b]
The new system required a change in the available area of the store, so this area has been made a bit bigger.

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
- Audio settings now saves when changed
- You can change the name of your store from your office in Single Store mode
- You are now asked if you want to leave the store when using the HUD.
- In some areas the currency was not used properly.
- Adjusted collision on displays so they fit better against each other.


[h2]--- Save games ---[/h2]

All of this comes with a bit of bad news. All of these changes weren't fully compatible with your save games. So when you load your stores the next time, you will notice a few changes. 

- First of all your walls and floors will be painted in the default materials, as these are reset to support the changes.

- Some of your doors might have been moved. The new system couldn't easily figure out where a door was when loading an old store. So a door between your areas will be placed at random, which might lead to down packing of inventory, and areas that are hard to access.

- In some of your campaign levels you have the possibility to expand your store even though you shouldn't be able to.

I always try to make all of your saves compatible from update to update, and spend a large amount of time in doing so. Unfortunately these changes were too big, so I am sorry for this, and the inconvenience it causes.


[h2]--- Translations ---[/h2]

The translations to the various languages are also improving at a steady rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/b0a4dff47a7b51e4257ecb1a2bb49b2644989a43.png[/img]

Danish, Dutch and Russian are translated in house, so these languages will not be updated as frequently form the translate as the rest.

To help with translations, go to https://translate.kingofretail.com.


[h2]--- Active users on discord ---[/h2]

There have been a good amount of activity on the discord lately, and especially in regards to testing the beta. A lot of bugs have been found and great feedback have been given, making my work much easier. And in this regard there have been some users who provided an exceptional amount of help, so I would like to give these an extra appreciation. These are: 

wfa, CrspyChcknLickn, El Caponey, eclipsifuggs and exapsy.

Thanks a lot for the help :-D

Make sure you join us on Discord!


[url=https://www.Discord.gg/fckN6bE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/2d23cbd46a7bf387d488e366c7d3f547ff26728d.png[/img][/url]


[b]This was it for now. I hope you will enjoy the new changes and possibilities, and as always i am very interested in listening to your feedback, ideas and any bugs you encounter.
I will head off again to start work on the next batch of improvements.

So until next time, happy sales.
//Daniel[/b]

notes.title: Letter to our retailers (12)
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

A month into the new year, and it's time for an update about what the last month was all about.
As I mentioned in the previous letter, I am now assisted by a new graphics artist who will help create a lot of new assets for the game. This should make the production faster than before, as I now can focus more on programming new and exciting features for the game. It is also nice to have someone else join on the development itself, so this is a much welcome addition.

- Note - 
This stuff is not available for play yet, but will be when the next update arrives.[/b]

[h2]--- Store Fronts ---[/h2]
She has also been thrown right in the middle of things from the beginning, and has already created lots of new stuff that will be added to the game. First of all, a whole new lot of store fronts for you to select and choose from, for customizing your stores even more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/56df017e530808b4981679930e5f22ca4cac54cd.png[/img]

They also look much better than the previous facade, so should bring a general lift to the overall look.

The facades themselves can off course also be customized in various ways, by customizing colors, the sign and the store name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/dc6cbc94b6a08d32be1fa23442e1642038cecdb2.png[/img]

[h2]--- Showcasing ---[/h2]

Another new feature of the facades is the ability to showcase desired articles, such that you can influence your customers even more. 
Want to start a trend of selling a specific computer or sports jersey? Show it in your window and watch the sales of that article increase. But remember to change it once in a while, as the customers also will grow tired of watching the same article in your windows over and over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/399866a676f2d83de22d486513ffe642ce1b16c6.png[/img]

The window displays themselves are rather simple in looks, but will also be upgraded.


[h2]--- Floors & Walls ---[/h2]

To accompany the general graphics improvements, the selection of floors and walls will also be expanded, and give you many new possibilities to design your stores.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/8e4ba9c880cc3eaa303ec56400e7a0a104d84b5f.jpg[/img]

I cant share an image of the new walls as they are being made right this moment, but they will definitely also be an improvement to the game.


[h2]--- New build system ---[/h2]

Most of the above is graphics. So what have I actually been spending my time on?

To allow for much of this, a pretty significant part of the game had to be recreated from scratch. 
The system that managed procedural building of your stores was one of the first things to be added to the game, and was created when i was still tumbling about, learning how to work properly, resulting in a system that was... less good.

This will not in itself be that visible in game, as its core functionalities that have been changed. However it was changed for a reason which allows for new and interesting stuff.

First of all the UI when building store was made more intuitive. I have had many reactions and questions on how to build the store, so hopefully a proper menu will make it much more straightforward. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/cc7e986b1b9e9785414a2460e639e4eee934cecc.png[/img]

This also allows for moving the facade to a different location, as well as a feature which many of you has requested for long. Free placed walls

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3135b2b2c5510190111b0e7763cb1bf585a0f905.png[/img]

This means that you can now separate your store up some more, and get rid of the "Big Room" look that always came along with running a big store.

One of the major flaws of the system, was that the game didn't knew how the floor plan was arranged before the level itself was actually loaded, which made for lots of limitations.

However with this new system it also make for possibilities in areas you might not think of.
So now when opening a store in your corporation you will now be able to select from multiple floor plans when opening a store, making it less of a lottery on what you get.

- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/dca42b2ab3f7c0b63d27f541e1a49d3038ec7d5d.png[/img]

This also allow for some interesting feature possibilities when it's time to take a look at improving Campaign mode.

[h3]--- Next Up ---[/h3]

So this is basically what one month of work has looked like. A few things still remain to be added to the next update. This will be the new walls, and an upgraded look for the ceiling, so it also will be upgraded with the rest of the store.

When this is done a Beta will be released, so the bugs that I miss can be caught before the actual release of this version.



[b]So this was the info I had to share for now. Feedback, comments and ideas are always much welcome.

Make sure you join us on Discord!

[url=https://www.Discord.gg/fckN6bE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/2d23cbd46a7bf387d488e366c7d3f547ff26728d.png[/img][/url]

Until next time:
Have a great sale

Best regards:
Daniel[/b]

notes.title: V 0.11 is out! Posters, Currencies and new UI
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers!

Two months have already gone by, time flies by fast. But these two months has not gone idly by. Again a lot of new updates and changes have made it into the game.[/b]


[h2]--- New Updates ---[/h2]

[h3]--- Currency converter ---[/h3]
Many of you have mentioned that prices are rather unrealistic in EUR or USD or other local currency. But in game currency has always been in DKK (Danish Krone) as that made it much easier for me to relate to that value, and when we started programming, we didn't give it much thought. 
However, this is now finally changed with the arrival of the currency converter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/4a6e7da5c866c5580f007904500f2bb59e24b434.jpg[/img]

With this you can select from some predefined currencies, or define your very own. So hopefully it will allow for a more relatable experience.

[h3]--- Poster System ---[/h3]
A couple of updates ago posters were introduced to the game to lift the visuals of the stores. However as I have learned some new tricks since then, this have been upgraded even further.

First of all you can now create your own posters in-game with the Poster Editor. Add and transform shapes, add various patterns and select their color. Add texts, add an image of an article, and so on. You can also upload your own images and use these as in-game posters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/6e2570d74fce49e897715a2f1ebba24fda965ae5.gif[/img]

These posters can be placed different places. First of all the displays all uses this system now, allowing for much more variety on these. 

But you can also buy frames and place these on the floor, on the wall and make them hang from the ceiling. You can also place them just outside your store, meaning you can decorate a bit on the outside too.

Also now the posters actually influence the customers.
As you can define if a poster advertises cheap articles or perhaps quality articles, you can influence your customers to buy articles in a specific direction. You can also advertise a specific article, and create hype for it.


[h2]--- UI updates ---[/h2]

[h3]--- Main Menu ---[/h3]
It was also time to change the main menu from its late 90's look to something a bit more modern. Also since some languages weren't supported by the font that was used it needed to change. 
So I gave it an overhaul in an attempt to make it look a bit more modern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/0362c977ebc3f2840620fc2972336356c1927549.png[/img]

Whether i succeeded or not is for you to decide, but I think it's an acceptable look. 

[h3]--- In Game Menu ---[/h3]
But seeing the change of this, I wanted to bring a similar look to the in game menus itself. So each in game menu has also been given an overhaul

Hopefully it will make the game look more unified, without having lots of different UI styles all over.
There are some screens that are left behind, but this is because they will be completely redone in a later patch anyway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/41fced2100d915cb0f765a092da4c2873412973e.jpg[/img]

[h3]- Ordering menu -[/h3]
During the overhaul, it made sense to completely overhaul some of the menus instead.
One of these was the ordering menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9be7463c79f8f00f5ba50a6cdedcef9de3802401.jpg[/img]

I have added a lot of the features that you have requested over time. 
First of all it has been organized better, which should make stuff more intuitive. Secondly there are options to how it counts the stock, as well as the price to display. Then you have various ways of ordering, as well as various possibilities for that ordering type. 
I hope this is more to your liking compared to the old version.

[h3]--- Catalogue Designer ---[/h3]

This was also a screen that made more sense to change completely. So hopefully it is also now a bit more intuitive, as well as containing more explanations on what the various stuff do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/83fe63d6a56702ff03b3ee52744b4a2667a4e5d3.jpg[/img]


[h2]--- Minor additions ---[/h2]

[h3]--- New language: Russian ---[/h3]
Thanks to our publisher, the game is also now fully translated in Russian by one of the employees that actually speaks the language (compared to the Google Translating i use to fill out remaining words that haven't been translated in our community translator).

So this is the current standing of the translations:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/da5d66573a1f8fd62c3c2801bb25c5843aa37815.png[/img]

If you want to help out improving a language you can go to:
https://translate.kingofretail.com/

[h3]--- Other changes ---[/h3]
A lot of bugs has also been fixed, as well as other minor features has been changed or added. The main ones to mention is:

- The color picker is now full screen, and doesn't take up UI space when not used. It will be improved with easier color selection in the future.
- At your office the polaroids seemed to stack on top of each other. They shouldn't any more.
- A bug where changing opening hours didn't update staff properly has been fixed.
- Copy pasting colors can be done across both registers and displays
- Shoes have been made a bit more expensive.

Again, reports on bugs you encounter are more than welcome :-)


[h2]--- Other Information ---[/h2]
[h3]--- Next up ---[/h3]
Finally, after all of this time doing it myself, I now have a graphics artist helping me. And this should hopefully speed the work flow up a lot.
In fact she is already preparing stuff for the next update, which will mostly focus on store fronts, store building and more decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f959e44dae1eca8b554c0e57a49e16e6166ae329.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/99ca7073fc2c6541f593a76f13cadb77eaf2d2c6.png[/img]

This is an early draft, but this and more is what you can expect in the future. More on what actually will be possible will be explained in later posts.

[h3]--- Boubers ---[/h3]
I sometimes just look around the internet to see what is happening, and sometimes i even sumble across something interesting :P
On youtube we found this channel, created by Boubers. Currently he is at his 236'th video of King of Retail. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wmwoa9RPHu0&list=PLsplF0RK5hvtUVyLDf1iyuc79xwDvfiWT&index=234&ab_channel=Boubers

That is quite a humbling dedication, so I wanted to pay my respects in return and share his channel with the rest of you.



[b]This is what I had to tell about this update. 
I hope you will enjoy the changes and the new features.
Feedback, bug reports and great ideas are always welcome both here and on our discord.
Feel free to join it here: [url=https://discord.gg/fckN6bE]Discord[/url]


Until next time, have a great sale.

Cheers
Daniel[/b]

notes.title: King of Retail - Poster design contest!
notes.content:
Dear Retailers,

I’m happy to see that some of you have already started fiddling around with the poster maker, which is currently still in beta. Being in an early state, it doesn’t have any stock poster backgrounds yet, meaning you still have to make your own from scratch. That’s a lot of work to do each time, and that’s why I’m launching a very exciting contest!


[h2]The Contest[/h2]
The general gist of the contest is simple: [b]design your own poster background![/b] Whether you’re creatively gifted or can’t tell a brush from a paint bucket, I’d urge everyone to participate!

[h2]The Rules[/h2]
Of course, there are some specifics to hash out. To enter the contest, please follow these rules:

[list]
[*] You must deliver both a horizontal and vertical background, meaning 708x1000 pixels (landscape), and 1000x708 pixels (portrait).
[*] [b]Alternatively[/b] you could create two banner poster backgrounds, which are 357x1000 pixels and 1000x357 pixels, respectively.
[*] You must use your background to make one poster in the in-game poster maker, as a proof of concept. [b]To access the poster maker[/b], right-click King of Retail in your Steam library > Click [i]Properties[/i] > go to the Beta tab > switch to the Beta branch.
[*] You must upload your designs in [url=https://discord.com/invite/YWeg8Hzhj7]the #submit channel on our official Discord server.[/url]
[*] You can create something new from scratch, or use royalty-free images, nothing under copyright.
[*] Nothing NSFW/Politics/Religion related.
[*] No transparency in your image, it messes with the poster maker!
[/list]

Apart from those three mentioned above, you are free to go with whatever theme you like! Cute dogs? Sure. A majestic sunrise? Go for it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9e64bbe2bfa779ca85c7cc58bc07bba2eb0005c7.jpg[/img]


[h2]The Prizes[/h2]
Probably the coolest prize is that winning poster backgrounds will be implemented in the game! That’s right, you could see your poster appear in other people’s playthroughs.

Adding to that, you can be further immortalized by having your gamertag appear in the game. “How?” you ask? Well, your gamertag will randomly show up on job applications! Note: I do not recommend putting your gamertag on [i]actual[/i] job applications.

And last but not least, winners will receive a Steam key for King of Retail to give out! It is the season of giving, after all.

[h2]Examples[/h2]
Below are some examples!

I'm excited to see what you all come up with!

Have a great sale.

notes.title: Letter to our retailers (11)
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers!

It has been 2 weeks since the release of the last update, and it is time to let you know a bit about what i have been working on, and tell you what you can expect in the next update.[/b]

[h2]--- Custom Currencies ---[/h2]

Many of you have commented that prices are too hign in general, and that you would like to see them regulated. 

However it doesn't state anywhere in the game what the currency is, but from what i can tell, you mentally translate them into your local currencies, which in hindsight obviously makes sense.
Americans mentions that it's an unrealistic amount in USD, and europeans, that it is an unrealistic amount in Euros.
As i am from Denmark they are actually based in DKK (Danish Kroner), so when we started making the game, there wasn't given much thought to the perception of the currency, and we just made it easy on ourselves to so we could understand the prices within the game.
However i can see the problem, and the loss of immersion when everything is percieved at unrealistic prices.
So i have addressed this issue, and been working on a currency converter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/def8260955276cd8c9060dc27b8434a036f9dc01.png[/img]

With this you can select a currency and then write how much your desired currency is compared to that, regulating all prices within the game. Hopefully it will allow you to see the prices at a more acceptable level.


[h2]--- Poster Designer ---[/h2]

Many of you have also been wanting to add more stuf fto your stores, other than inventory and articles. To accomodate this, i have started working on in store decorations.

The experience gained from the in-game logo designer in the previous release, has allowed me to think in different ways of allowing you to customize your stores. 
So based on this i created an in-game poster editor. With this you can select from a variety of shapes, fonts and patters, and change them in a number of ways to create your own unique posters. 
It will also, like the logo editor, allow you to upload your own images, which you can use as a poster on it's own, or as a background to work on with the rest of the editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a446cb55c8751ec1e341b47c1cc703c78da86626.png[/img]

I already look forward to see the creative posters i imagine you will come up with ːsteamhappyː


[h2]--- Store Posters ---[/h2]

The posters should of course also be put to good use. So you will also be able to place the posters in your stores.
There will be signs to place them on the floor, casings to put them on the wall, or you can even let them hang from the ceiling.
You can add them in various shapes and sizes, and some of them can even be backlit, allowing you create a poster that lights up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/6da14f8c03c4ff13fee86d0d5f1f69d7bd8b9804.png[/img]

The signs will also influence your customers. As you can define what type of poster you have (Does it advertize for a certain category, for cheap articles, or perhaps the latest trends?) these posters will allow you to attract your customers and influence them into buying what you want them to.

Although not implemented yet, but my next task is also to allow you to set up signs outside of your store, allowing you to make an inviting store front and giving you a new way to attract customers into the store. 

These posters will also replace the current system on all of the displays, giving you the same possibilities there.

[b]
So this is what i have spent the last two weeks on, and it will probably take some more days to complete. However this is only a small part of the decorations upgrade, as other things will be added right after. So i hope it will be an exiting upgrade to the game.

And as always, bug reports, ideas and feedback are most welcome, and don't hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/fckN6bE]Discord[/url].

Until next time.
Have a great sale.[/b]

notes.title: Update v.0.10.3: Give me my tablet!
notes.content:
Dear Retailers,

[u]The latest version is now live! [/u]

Initially, this update only included new tablets. However, along the way a bit more stuff has been added. This combined with the new partnership with Iceberg Interactive, the brand new publishers of the game, has resulted in a longer development period than originally intended. 

Let’s have a look at the new content:

[h2]--- Tablets ---[/h2]

As mentioned, tablets have been added to the game. More precisely, 60 of them.
Tablets are part of the Mobile Devices category, which falls under the electronics departments. The new addition of tablets means that it should now be possible to run a specialized electronic store focusing mainly on Mobile Devices or Computers. The electronics department was lacking in content, so I am aiming to correct this with today's and future updates. That’s right, more articles will be added in the future.

As a category, Tablets are priced in between Computers and Phones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/357f745feeb44d54e036f47c54e2bed3c801928d.png[/img]

[h2]--- Logo designer ---[/h2]

The system of importing your own logos to the game has always been a bit confusing and buggy if you used more than one. So instead of trying to fix this, it was much easier to make a completely new system! You can now import logos directly from the main menu, and let the system handle the files and the weird names they should be given. This system should make it a whole lot easier to customize your stores to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/ddf1540c14ee237d94a24024152348a2ecb8357f.png[/img]

If it works as it should without unexpected issues, I plan to use the same system to customize posters and signs inside your stores in the future. So please do let me know your feedback! 


[h2]--- New calendar ---[/h2]

After adding all the days, weeks and months to the game, I found out that the calendar didn’t support this system, and had a lot of bugs. So like the logo designer, it was easier to create a new system. The calendar now focuses on the week ahead, instead of an entire month, which is quite some time in-game and probably included too much information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/8bb02192199fc2b80c9604fe3d4dee5d6bb0c5aa.png[/img]

[h2]--- Applications ---[/h2]

The applications were also an old remnant from a system created two years ago. So instead of pinned photos lying on your desk, it now has proper applications. From these applications, you might also learn something about the person before conducting the interview, allowing you to save time when looking for the right employee for your store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d6fb58952b273ce861295498fdc94eb26805ed3d.png[/img]

[h2]--- Other bugs ---[/h2]

I have also spent some time solving a whole lot of bugs. Of these, the most significant fixes are:
-	When you fired an employee, you were unable to move away from the board.
-	Renegotiating a wage made you unable to use the advertising table.
-	The lot info board in corporation mode now shows the correct amount of employees.
-	Fixed collision on some articles and freezers.
-	Some colors did not update correctly when designing your displays.
-	Staff wouldn't go to a specific register when placed too close to a wall.
-	Cancelling while adding/removing articles from the display actually cancels the display.
-	Tooltips added to various buttons.
-	Beverages can now be sorted by supplier when selecting those.
-	Updated translations from community translator and fixed a few typo’s

[h2]--- Translations ---[/h2]

The translations are also, as always, making progress with each update. I can’t thank you enough for helping me translate the game into your language. 

This is the current progress so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/c6e3a7541520a374c6ec010bc7ef1354fa2dce55.png[/img]


[b]This is it for the current update! I hope you will enjoy the changes. If you encounter any bugs please don’t hesitate to let me know so that they can be fixed.[/b]

Feel free to join our Discord at: [url=https://discord.gg/fckN6bE]https://discord.gg/fckN6bE[/url]

And if you want to help translating the game, go to: [url=https://translate.kingofretail.com/]https://translate.kingofretail.com/[/url]

Until next time, have a great sale.

Daniel

notes.title: King of Retail has teamed up with Iceberg Interactive!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers!

There is exciting news for King of Retail.

Over the last months, I have been talking to the Iceberg Interactive team.
This is a company specializing in game publishing, and they loved King of Retail enough to want to partner up.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/92d89bc6107f7d7c6b6fa31bd7ca7629804f7154.png[/img]

[b]So what does this actually mean.[/b]
First of all this brings some professionalism into the project. 
Up until now the game, and everything regarding it, has been done as I see fit and believed was right in that moment, but since this is the first game I have been working on, everything has been learned by trial and error. 
This means that I have learned a lot, but also that lot of time has been spent focusing on some wrong aspects of the game. In this regard it’s nice to team up with a team of experienced publishers, who behind the scenes already have helped me a lot in improving the way I work, as well as helping me in optimizing the project structure of the game itself.
They will also assist in lots of various tasks that takes up a lot of my time and I hardly know anything about, which prevent me spending time on the stuff that I actually want to do, which is working on and improving the game itself, making your King of Retail experience even better.

[b]What it DOESN’T mean[/b]
is that King of Retail will become a totally different game. I am still the person behind the game, and I will still be the one working on it on a daily basis. Instead they will assist in providing feedback and testing, as well as helping me finding resources to assist me in the development where this is needed. 
Again, helping me to divert my workload to work on improving the game. 
And if I have a question or a problem, I now have access to an army of kind and competent people, which is in high contrast to having to find a solution to everything myself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/4c5719379c106028885d600ebb2d1dd72f51542c.png[/img]

This allows for possibilities that I didn’t dare dream of when I started working on the game, and the daily work already now feels “larger” as compared to working alone day in and day out. So I am as motivated as ever to work on the game and I can’t wait to see the future of King of Retail.

And look! They even helped me with this new and cool logo for my company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/56c1472eec15fde4320da1bd3814723b5d3cd244.png[/img]

Check out their exciting array of games, which King of Retail also now is a part of.

https://www.iceberg-games.com/

I hope you approve of the new changes, and I know you can expect a lot of interesting stuff to happen in the future.

[b]Until next time - happy sales.

Cheers
Daniel[/b]

notes.title: Letter to our retailers (10)
notes.content:
[b]Dear retailers!

It's been over a month since the last update came out, so it's about time you get some information about what the time has been spent on.[/b]


[h2]----- Tablets -----[/h2]
As promised, electronics need to be expanded further. So some of the time has been spent making tablets, which is an item to be sold along with the mobile devices, so there is a little more content in this category.
My goal is for these items to be available next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /34023693/357f745feeb44d54e036f47c54e2bed3c801928d.png [/img]


[h2]----- Bug fixes ----- [/h2]
I have also fixed a few bugs and will probably fix a few more before I release the next update.

[b]Selling your lot in corporation games actually sells your property.[/b]

There was a problem that when you sold your property it was not removed, but it still gave you the money from the sale. Basically, it could give you infinite money, but I'm sorry to say that is no longer possible.

The calendar had to be completely redone due to several things. It was created for the original system without weeks and months, so all months were therefore 31 days in the calendar, which caused the calendar to show wrong things occasionally. Most of the time last month is spent on something completely different. Something I have not dared to talk about before that I was sure it happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7235bc71292a6b9b186c8b6166cda8b849fb4f04.png[/img]


[b]That was all for now. So keep an eye out for a new update which (hopefully) arrives next week, and look out for the announcement.
Remember that you can still help translate the game at translate.kingofretail.com, and also feel free to join our Discord server at https://discord.gg/fckN6bE.

So until next time then, happy sales.[/b]

notes.title: V. 0.10.2 is ready - You need a phone?
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers
Another update is ready for you!
[/b]

As Electronics are receiving some much needed attention, the articles will be added in packs as they are being completed. This makes for shorter development periods, but also lesser content in each update.

[h2]--- Category changes ---[/h2]
First of all a new subcategory has been added. Mobile Devices is a new entry under the Electronics segment. This will in future contain items such as phones, tablet as well as other smartunits and various  accessories. This is what will be fleshed out with new articles over the next few patches, such that Electronics in general will contain a lot more and be as comprehensive as the other categories.
Peripherals has for a long time only contained a few amount of mice and nothing else.
This was not enough to sustain a high level category on its own fits better as a part of under Computers. So from now on these articles will feature here instead.
For corporation players, this means that articles from Peripherals now are affected by your Computer reputation.
Mobile Devices have then in turn replaced the Peripherals, so those of you who have gotten a great reputation with Peripherals will now be able to sell a lot of Mobile Devices immediately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7932eeaf31e49a943acf3f7eabfeec0d23f69d9a.png[/img]

[h2]--- Phones ---[/h2]
For starters the new category will contain a total of 60 phones from the 3 suppliers PearEasy, LED-D and Firestorm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/2592d907edef941b9da4af1d528f7b43ae563ac2.png[/img]

These are priced quite a bit below computers but are still the second most expensive category in the game. So compared to Peripherals, it already now contains more articles, as well as it should be easier to run a store / concept only selling these items.

[h2]--- Other minor changes ---[/h2]

[h3]- Enlarged images[/h3]

To be able to distinguish between articles, an enlarged image will now show up each time you cursor is above an article within the menus. This being ordering, placing, statistics and every other menu containing an article. 

[h3]- Article spacing[/h3]

The articles in the Computer category now needs a little more space between them on the displays. It looked kind of wrong having 6 highend computers crammed up against each other. This space will present them better, but you will of course not be able to have as many on display simultaneously. This is also done to balance Computers out a bit, since they generate far too much income compared to the other categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/576990d2624572e80074556863482615310eff58.png[/img]

[h3]- Complimentary sales[/h3]

Moving these categories around caused an issue to the customers article calculations. Usually, when a customer takes an article, they receive a penalty for that category, which reduces their desire to pick an article again. 
But now where the expensive computers, and the much lower priced mice are at the same category, it made for a system where you would actually earn less when also selling mice on top of computers.

So now complimentary types is introduces. So when buying a computer, the desire to buy a mouse is barely changed and vice versa. This should hopefully increase sales for articles that support each other.

At the moment there aren't really any other articles who are considered complimentary, but when accessory types arrives for the various categories this will allow for more dynamic play and interesting choices.



[b]This was it for this update. I will head back and create some more articles.

Also, join the discord server at:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

Until next time. Happy sales[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.10.1 is out "Got something to drink?"
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers!

A month has gone by since the last release, but now a new update is finally available.[/b]


[h2]--- Beverages --- [/h2]
Since the entry of the groceries, i promised to add various drinks to the game. So this month has been about designing bottles, bottles and more bottles. This has resulted in over 170 new articles that will enter the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/76df56a461ccba5ff114c4d563842cf6e8c2e34f.png[/img]

They are spread out in 4 types. Wine, Beer, Soda and Liquor.
All of them are in the low luxury, however wine and liquor are quite high compared to the other grocery articles as well as being priced a bit higher.
This makes for some articles in the "Groceries" category that allows for a higher income, compared to the existing ones. 
Feedback indicated that it was relatively hard to make a "Groceries" department survive in the long run, so hopefully this will help making it easier to run a supermarket.


[h2]--- Displays ---[/h2]
The new articles also comes with a few new displays. 3 in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/1e5e28e1a22ff6a4bb249623c3c86f39be34fc27.png[/img]

Two of them are specific, made only for adding bottles to them, while the larger one is a general type display, which can also be used for other items.


[h2]--- Bugfixes & Balancing ---[/h2]
General programming has not been in focus for this update. However there has still been some issues which has been fixed.

- Staff not meeting for work.
There were issues where staff wouldn't show up for work. Apparently when assigning their schedule, if you clicked to the left of the opening hours this hour would be recorded as the meeting hour. But since this was before the store opened, they would never meet for work. They should now meet as desired.

- Problems of proceeding past tutorial.
When opening a new store, there is the basic tutorial of what to buy. If you hide the UI by menu or TAB, this screen was no longer focusable by the mouse, and made it impossible to end the day. 
This has also been fixed as well as making the "End Day" button available, so it will also be possible to skip this entirely.

- Register speed.
The speed at the registers have been adjusted again. Some articles were processed way to fast (some as quick as 0.1 seconds), making it possible to clear giant queues in no time. 
So this has been adjusted back a bit, and in general making it take a bit longer to process a customer.


[h2]--- Translations ---[/h2]
Translations are also making slow and steady progress.
To help with translating, go to: https://translate.kingofretail.com/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/21b64ae6f66018dcbb08560075a44705eb0365f3.png[/img]


[h2]--- Up next ---[/h2]
Now it is time for... more articles. 
Electronics was added a long time ago, however it has been left alone and with far too few articles. 
The reason for this was the sizes of general electronic products made it difficult to come up with articles and categories that would fit together. But with the introduction of shelf and autofitting displays this is no longer a problem.
So now it is time to fill up this category with lots of new items. What items that will be specifically i do not know yet. But i promise it will be a welcome and interesting addition.

I will also aim to add these articles in smaller intervals so when a pack is ready, it will be uploaded as soon as possible.


[b]This was it for now. Feedback is as always welcome.
Also, join our discord at: https://discord.gg/fckN6bE
Until next time. Happy sales.[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.10.0 is released "The Weekday Manager"
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

The next version is finally out and ready for you to play. First of all i will apoligize for the elongated development time of this update, but i moved to a new location last month and had to work a lot to make it a liveable home.

However on the good side, i will from next week be getting some extra help making the game from a friend who wants to learn how to make graphics. His job will be to add content in various areas, and in general help with the time consuming tasks, such that i can better focus on the programming itself.
So hopefully it will be a good addition, allowing to add new and interesting things to the game.

The Admin team has also been expanded on the discord with two new members who have been so kind to help out answering your questions, and keep a great atmosphere, and they are doing a great job at it.

But now to the update.[/b]


[h2]--- The week ---[/h2]
The main focus of this update has been to introduce the week, meaning that we now have days and months instead of just a simple day counter. And this brings a lot of new interesting things to the game.

[h3]--- Staff scheduling ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/637a8d873a9c14f7c2c77d106efa50e2c4d9ba41.png[/img]
You can now set the schedule of each staff for the individual days of the week including assigning days off and different roles on each day. So it possible to tailor a complete schedule that will make the store run smoothly from day to day.

[h3]-- Customer flows[/h3]
The week also allows for different customer flows for each day. So farmers might prefer to shop on a monday, where the techies goes shopping on thursdays instead. And in the weekends everyone has a completely different shopping pattern compared to the workdays. So it's up to you to learn the different patterns and set up the store accordingly.

[h3]-- Opening hours[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/4d316e8d11fe6cd574ef24761441b0e6857c2ed5.png[/img]
Because of the different customer flows you might also want to keep different opening hours for your store so this is also possible now.

[h2]--- New Hud ---[/h2]
The main HUD in the store has also received an overhaul, to make it a bit more modern looking compared to the old one. This new hud also allows for some new features which you have requested.

[h3]--- First Person View ---[/h3]
It is now possible to play the game from a first person view. Feedback on how this mode han be improved is very welcome.

[h3]--- Hiding the HUD ---[/h3]
It is also now possible to hide the hud, for those of you who want to take better screenshots of your stores.

[h3]--- General Overhaul ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/80395222a10b5ab135b5c0d8cb1c5667b74da05c.png[/img]
The remaining screens has now been converted to the new style, and a few of them has received an overhaul.

[h2]--- Stats ---[/h2]
The stats system has also changed. The previous one caused lagging in longer games because of some bad code structure. So while doing this overhaul, some new features have been added.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d4246e6ed448871d7e553a2012587b54f431d2b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3df6d515deb2af53d487a937d6ccf148f5095d61.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/93d1ee84a070eacabc582766fe84fe78e389da66.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/958a2b65871b1cc54ea068d24863e6e5b32863ec.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a8bec77369c723c00886c30ebdcf2d4cf500967a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f26782a78fef3a57d337b655e50d6416f31358bd.png[/img][/url]

The customers will now give you feedback of their experience while shopping at your store through customer reports. It is also now possible to see what each segment perfers in a more understandable way. Finally you can also see the shopping stats for the segments on each day. So hopefully these tools will make it easier to make decisions on what to do. 
All of this can be found on your computer in your office.

[h2]--- Minor Updates ---[/h2]
Besides this, other features have also been added.

[h3]--- Minimum Storage Sytem on articles ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/187961aa616b40dd7577b98cccbf62fb72329196.png[/img]
You can now adjust the desired amount of articles used by the Minimum Storage Info directly on the articles using the Edit Article menu

[h3]--- Customers Queuing ---[/h3]
There have been lots of complaints regarding the queuing of the customers. They should now be more intelligent, and spread out to the various registers. 

[h3]--- ABC locations ---[/h3]
Have you got some articles you want to get rid of, or want more sales of that high earning item? Then make the customers see this as the first thing when they enter your store.
You can now add focus on various articles in your store. The closer a display is to the store front, the more interesting it will be for the customer to look at. 

[h3]--- Register speed by article ---[/h3]
There were some balancing issues regarding selling groceries. As these are low priced items, the customers will now take more of each. However this then added longer queues at the registers. To combat this, the amount of time it takes to process an article now also depends on the luxury of that item. So selling a food item at the register, will now be faster than selling a computer.
In future more will be added to balance out various categories.

[h3]--- Corp Applications ---[/h3]
The applications you receive will now be based of your HQ level. So when obtaining a bigger HQ, you will most likely get better applicants.

[h2]--- Bugs ---[/h2]
As always lots of bugs have been corrected, and a lot new has most likely entered. Thanks to all of you who have beta tested the game, and provided feedback.

[h3]--- Menu centering ---[/h3]
There were some issues with ingame menus having weird offsets on other resolutions than the standard 1920 x 1080. This should have been corrected, and menus should now appear on top of their respective inventory.

[h3]--- LMB missing once in a while ---[/h3]
There have been a longstanding issue with LMB suddently not registering when placing items. I can't get this to happen myself, so can't track it down. However i have tried to fix some of the areas that might cause this, but if it continues to happen i am very interested in hearing about it.

[h2]--- What's next? ---[/h2]
So with this update out, what are the upcoming plans?

[h3]-- The stand by period ---[/h3]
As always after a large update, there is a "Stand By" period, meaning i don't do larger changes for a week or so, but instead stand ready to fix bugs that might arrive, such that a fix can be made and uploaded quickly. So a few minor patches might arrive during the upcoming week.

[h3]--- More articles (And this time it's true) ---[/h3]
It was the meaning that more articles should have been added this patch. However a lot of feedback indicated that it was a huge task managing the staff each day on larger stores. Therefore the only solution to this was to add a complete week such that you could add fixed days off for your staff, so that it would be more automated.
But with this out of the way, it is time to add articles as promised. There will first be added various drinks, to round off the groceries category, and after that all attention will go to expand electronics.
This will probably happen over two several patches, but work on this will start tomorrow.

This was the info regarding this update. Please do let me know of bugs, balancing issues, thoughts or great ideas.
Also feel free to join our discord at:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

notes.title: Letter to our Retailers (7) - The Weekday
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers!

It has been some time since the latest newsletter, and the even the world has changed since then.

WIth all of this happening as well as some other stuff, i decided to take a few weeks off, with minimal work on the game to get everything sorted again. This is also why the newsletter hasn't been out for an extended period.

However there has still been work, and lots of new things to tell about :-)[/b]


[h2]--- V 0.9.4 ---[/h2]
A few minor updates has been released, mainly focusing on removing bugs, and making a few optimizations. 

Primarily there was a bug affecting the bigger stores, where staff preferred filling articles over unpacking, resulting in them not unpacking at large stores where there are always something to fill. This has been changed around, so that they prefer to unpack over adding.
At some point the job / task system will be reworked completele, as it doesn't allow for complete control of your staff which should be possible.

The latest update also added some new articles to the Groceries category, making it possible to sell various cleaning items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/448a8eb0a2394ae999d5514f59245807e78afe41.png[/img]


[h2]--- Up Next  ---[/h2]
Since then work has revolved around one of the community's greatest requests, the implementation of a "week", and this brings on a whole new set of features. Note that this is still work in progress, and not a part of the official game yet.

[h3]--- Staff Planning ---[/h3]
First of all, it will be possible to plan the entire workweek for all of your staff. This includes individual day schedule, days off, and various roles for the specific day.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/637a8d873a9c14f7c2c77d106efa50e2c4d9ba41.png[/img]


[h3]--- Opening Hours, and variying customer flows ---[/h3]
To accompany this it is also now possible to make various opening hours for each day. However this would not add anything if all days are similar. So now there will also be a different amount of customers for each day, with some days busier than others, which affect how much staff you need for a given day as well as when to do your promotions.
The days will also have a varying flow of customers, so at Mondays the rich people might shop late in the morning, and on fridays closer to the evening instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7073141e559ba896821052ccf1a4d8364261da3e.png[/img]

The plan is also to add some more statistics to the computer to help you analyse these new things.

[h2]--- Updated HUD  ---[/h2]
To do this, the HUD needed to be able to also contain weekdays. And since it... could look better, i decided to give it an overall upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/edc56f17d151e190d1236316571ced8199c7f819.png[/img]


It also contains some new features.

[h3]--- Keybindings --- [/h3]
There will now be keybindings to control simple things like the speed.

[h3]--- Hide UI ---[/h3]
There will be a button to hide the UI, for those who want to take better screenshots. This can also be toggled with tab.

[h3]--- First Person Mode ---[/h3]
It will be possible to view the game from your characters point of view.

[h2]--- Other UI updates  ---[/h2]
In general lot of the menus have been updated to the new look, which is done for two reasons. 
1. The old UI looked from it was made in the late 90's (The new isn't perfect but hopefully it looks more modern)
2. Much of it was made from the beginning of the game, where lots of errors and bad practices where used due to our lack of knowledge, so it has also been to upgrade this which allows for much easier changes in the future.

There will probably still be some remnants left of the old UI, but will also be changed. 
And at some point the entire Main Menu will receive a likewise overhaul, as this also could be improved a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9b501f414fa15a7013e6d27044860d35d38198a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/80395222a10b5ab135b5c0d8cb1c5667b74da05c.png[/img]

----------

[b]So this is what has happened since the last update. The next articles that will enter the game, is various drinks, and after that the electronics will receive some much needed attention.

Until next time, happy sales.[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 is out - The Supermarket Owner
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

The latest update is finally out, bringing a lot of new features into the game.

First of all a HUGE thank you, to all of you who have participated in the beta testing of this version. A lot of bugs have been found, as well as several features have been implemented and changed thanks to you. It has been extremely helpful, and have saved lots of time and frustrations, and hopefully it will bring a better experience to all of those going to play it.[/b]

[h2]-- Groceries --[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/5293b52f1c26405bd3b34abf578afe71b9a50e3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a3200610494cfd22174f88ee539ec438e421e900.png[/img]
The biggest feature is the new category "Groceries" which has been what this update is revolving around. It includes a whole new set of articles to sell in your stores. These are various canned and packaged foods, food for refrigeration, fruits and vegetables. Over the next updates even more articles will be added.

[h2]-- Displays --[/h2]
[h3]- Complete rework -[/h3]
For making this category work, the display system needed a complete overhaul. The old system only allowed for items of the same size. This system has been the main problem when we wanted to add new categories and articles.
The new system allows for categories to "share" displays while still being able to maintain some unique ones for that category only. They also allow articles of various sizes, and will automatically fit that. So a table might have 4 computers, but 8 mice. So this will make it much easier to add new articles to the game in the future. The new system also allow you to place a specific article at a specific location, which the staff will now respect. So you can now create a shoe wall featuring only unique shoes,if that is what you desire.

[h3]- Shelf types -[/h3]
A new type of display has also come to the game, the shelf display. This allow you to add shelves, and adjust these to the type of article you expect to show on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f2443003cf2abb95059f91296e84d3fd992cfadb.png[/img]

[h3]- Signs -[/h3]
All displays also now has the possibility to be equipped with a billboard you can customize with various texts, colors and patterns.

[h3]- Colors -[/h3]
We have also disposed of the old "Material Sphere" system. With this system, it was hard to make all interactables to be compatible with these generic materials, and also didn't allow for each display to receive a unique look. Now, the displays has received a unique look which you can colorize. The visuals for the displays will be further improved over the next updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e9538645bda82e990d7c66616a723ec5f7c9ddad.png[/img]

[h3]- Color picker -[/h3]
As this brings a lot of emphasis on colors, the color picker has also been upgraded and you can now save colors across stores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/21c00aecce0289f786bf2a7fa4220cd51b37cc49.png[/img]

[h2]-- UI --[/h2]
For all of this to happen, the UI for all of these things needed an upgrade. So we have tried with a new look, and new functionalities that supports the future of many categories and articles better than the old one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/fc3c7e0f093b209222fd10299cb51d30d2436fc8.png[/img]

[h2]-- Registers --[/h2]
[h3]- New types -[/h3]
We have also upgraded the looks and functionality off all the registers, as well as adding new ones to the game. The queues have also been changed, so in general they will occupy less space, than their old counterparts. They are all also now equpped with a status light, showing if they are open, closed for new customers or completely closed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/adf4be2ba899f0084a66238b3aa30bde4f65c0d3.png[/img]

[h3]- New functionality -[/h3]
The registers have also been changed to allow for various amounts of customers. So the small and cheap ones only allow for few customers, while the large and more expensive ones allows for more and also occupy more space.

[h2]-- Staff UI --[/h2]
We have added a menu to the hud showing all of your staff who are currently at work. From here you can assign them new tasks, or send them on break.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/695444f2c90a3b98caea70ebfcfe20e8fc2e47a3.png[/img]

[h2]-- Day Progress --[/h2]
[h3]- Closed for unlimited time -[/h3]
If you decide to close the store for an entire day, you will now have all the time in the world to redecorate your store. 

[h3]- Extra delivery -[/h3]
In the HUD, a new button has also been added under "Articles". With this you can request an extra article delivery for a fee. So you can during the day order extra articles if you run out of space or if you forgot to order.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/cb15d26dd1bd8b3931bec1668726db0fd0f1d8dd.png[/img]

[h2]-- Save Game Issues --[/h2]
Unfortunately, the new display system made the old ones obsolete to a point where they were incompatible with each other. So as a consequence, all displays have been removed from the stores. However we have compensated for this, by refunding the displays. The articles placed on them, have been added to be delivered the next day. You have received a compensation for each article that is going to be redelivered. Finally you have also received money for the rent of a missing day. We therefore recommend to close the store for a day to rebuild it, and you can request articles again and again during this day due to the new features.

We are terribly sorry for the inconveniences of this, but hopefully these compensations will ake it up to you.

[h2]-- Languages --[/h2]
[h3]- Player Translations -[/h3]
Our community translator also came into action during this patch. We weren't sure how it would turn out, but much to our suprise it has been widely used. We are very humbled that so many has taken their time to translate sentence after sentence. Thank you A LOT to all of you who have been assisting with this. This should have improved the existing languages, but we also tried adding new languages to the game. And even more to our suprise, some of you have taken their time to translate the game to an entire new language.

So a very special thank you to the following users:

Lucas (Translated the entire game into French)
WensElf (Translated the entire game into Dutch)
sztilo07 (Has translated over half the game into Hungarian)
iTzAlexandre (Has translated a quarter of the game into Portuguese)

[h3] - Back to english -[/h3]
Due to how these translations is made, some words might be incorrect, understood in the wrong context, extending a bounding box or missing, as the translators havent been able to test out their translations while translating, but could only see them in game when the beta was updated. Since the game automatically detects your language, you might start out your game in your local language. If you are, and you find any of the above annoying, you always have the possibility to swich back to English language.

[h3]- Want to help translating -[/h3]
If you want to help with the translations, go to:
https://translate.kingofretail.com/

[h2]-- Mac Issue --[/h2]
Finally, Mac users will have to wait a bit extra for this update.
We are making the game for windows, which allows for exporting to various platforms. However MacOS is not included in this. For building to Mac, Apple requires it to be done on a  n Apple device. We are currently experiencing some issues getting Unreal Engine (which is the program we create the game in) to run on Mac. We are trying to solve this, but we don't want to hold back the update for windows. So we are very very sorry that we can't offer you the update right away, but as soon as we are able to, we will provide it for you also.


------------------------------------------------------


[b]This rounds of the news of this update.
We are very interested in receiving feedback, ideas and hearing about bug or issues you may encounter. You can do that here at Steam or at our discord:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE[/b]

We hope you will enjoy the changes, and happy retailing out there :)

notes.title: Letter to our Retailers (6) - New Articles, new Languages and new features.
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Retailers.

it is time for a new letter, and we have made quite some progress since the last one.[/h3]

[h2]--- Groceries ---[/h2]
Since the last letter, our main focus has been on creating content for the groceries category, and this means adding lots of articles.

We have started out with two subcategories Canned Foood and Fresh Food. All articles are sold from the 3 companies, 
[list]
[*] Tasty Dreams - The cheap solution
[*] Organix - Fashion foods of a medium quality
[*] Diamond Standard - Focuses on high quality foods.
[/list]
Canned Food contains those items that can be placed on a regular shelf. Currently these are the aritcles that will be sold fom this category for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e42081ce8d7ada01772865e7e3a0019677d4d9c6.png[/img]

Fresh Food will need some sort of refrigeration unit to keep these cold. These are the articles made so far, however over the next couple of days, many more will be added to this category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/6394670caad25459c457a1f674f03c258ab0ae9d.png[/img]

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/21c00aecce0289f786bf2a7fa4220cd51b37cc49.png[/img]

Finally we have also made the access to your staff easier. So the HUD when in store, will now show all employees currently at work, as well as having the possibility to change tjeir task directly from the menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/695444f2c90a3b98caea70ebfcfe20e8fc2e47a3.png[/img]



[b]This is all for now. We aim to release a beta to test out this version, as it helped us quite a lot in the last update.

Feedback is very welcome, and a lot of you have joined our discord making it a fun place to be, along with providing with lots of ideas for us to work with.

If you haven't already, you can join at:

https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

Until next time :-)
[/b]

notes.title: Letter to our retailers (5) - Translation system and progress on groceries.
notes.content:
Dear Retailers

It is time for our next letter, explaining what we have been up to.

[h1]- Translation System -[/h1]

Yay, our translation system is finally up and running!

Over the time a lot of you has offered help with translating the game, both in existing languages, but also into new ones we haven't supported. And while we would love your help, setting up and handling the logistics was one of the main reasons why we have turned down the help. In December we finally set the time aside to create a system, where you can assist in translating as little or as much as you want to, and last week we were able to set it public.

To help out with translations go to:

https://translate.kingofretail.com/

As the system is completely new, feedback is also very welcome :)

[h1]- Displays -[/h1]

In our last letter we were preparing for groceries, and by that changing the displays to allow various sixed items. Most of the time has been spent on progression with these systems. 

They are finally at a place where we feel they are as we want them to be. However some of the systems as you know them as changed.

Some displays will be as you know them. Shirt displys will have the same amount of shirts as previous. However tables will carry as many as can fit in the width. So a table can maybe carry 4 computers but 6 mice, removing a lot of the wasted space on the smaller items.

The new shelf type, allows you to add shelves, and move them up and down so that it fits a lot ot articles without wasting too much space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/749654f5ddcc4287cbe2ae444e3c933e90a53a96.png[/img]

Displays will now be colored by your choice, rather than using the "Material orb" system. The orbs allowed for various materials, but the downside to this is that you cant make the various displays look up to their best, as they all have to fit these "generic" looks also.
Instead you will now be able to select which colors your displays should be, allowing for a more customizable look for your store. In future this will also allow that you can get more than one "skin" for each display. These skins are made specific for each display allowing them to look much more detailed than previsously. 
This also means that we have some work to do changing the existing displays, but hopefully it will bring an inprovement to overall graphics.

As an added bonus, all displays will allow for the option of adding a billboard to them. These borads can also be customized in various vays. This time it will go out as a test, but in the future this can be expanded so you will be able to hang these boards down from the ceiling, and also add your own graphics to it.


[h1]- Groceries -[/h1]

With the displays in order, we have just started yesterday adding articles to the groceries category, with the very first items being Cereal Boxes, with the two companies Tasty Foods and Organix fighting for the market.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/828b9f47ff78cc8f9e547ec5546244ae254a8045.png[/img]

Over the next weeks this category will of course be expanded with a lot of interesting articles, such that you can create your own supermarket.


[b]Until next time
Oh.. and don't hesitate to join our discord at:[/b]
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

[b]Happy sales[/b]

notes.title: Letter to our Retailers (4) - Preparing for groceries.
notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

It has been a little over a week since our latest release, and it seems you enjoy playing it. This allows us to look at the next update, instead of focusing on ironing out this one.

So what do we have planned?[/b]

[h1]--- New category: Groceries ---[/h1]

At our discord we had a vote on what you wanted the most. And the answer was without a doubt a new grocery category. So we started doing just that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9dec04f661789c27338da52293621ec6578fa654.png[/img]

We are still in the warly planning stages, so we have not decided what to put into it. We will probably start by making foods in various forms. Fruits, meats, vegetables and bread both in packed form (Boxes, bags and cans) and in fresher forms, such that these articles also fit to various types of customers. (Hint: So now is the best time for letting us know which articles you would like in these categories :) )

[h1]--- New Display Types ---[/h1]

One of our issues with adding categories like this, was the various sizes of the different items. This is currently shown with computers and mice, where the mice has an extraordinary large amount of space on these displays. 
Furthermore the category grouping would have to be based on their sizes and not their types. So a category for foods might be "Canned Goods" and "Boxed Goods", because the displays would fit these sizes. 

This is a big limitation, and has been one of the major reason on why we have held back on adding various articles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e105cecc086e201d81b9f853d79a7303ec19c77e.png[/img]

So now we have changed the display system entirely, and allowed for some more general displays. These displays fit automatically fit to the size of the item displayed. As you see at the image the computers and mice fit on the same display, but with various amounts shown. It also allows for mice and computers to be shown on the same shelf, and still keeping individual sizes for it's spot. 

So now we can tag items to the types of displays that can carry them. For instance shoes can be tagged "Shoes" and "General". This allows for the creation of specific displays, while also allowing for multi-article displays.

[h1]--- New Interaction & Display UI ---[/h1]

These display types require a new method of handling, and this allowed us to kill two birds with one stone. We would like to clean up the UI and make it take up less space on screen. We would also like to make the UI just a bit more modern that the current '90's look it has.
So the UI when interacting with things in-store will receive an overhaul. 
The original system was one of the first things we made when starting building the game, and therefore suffered from our general lack of knowledge on structuring a game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/fc3c7e0f093b209222fd10299cb51d30d2436fc8.png[/img]

The new system will allow for even more control of a display. Now you can manage each individual spot, instead of only an area, which for instance allows for a shoe wall with a different shoe on each spot and correct refilling by the staff.


[b]These are the main features we will focus on during this update, and we look forward to continue working on them and telling you aboutthe updates. Comments are as always appreciated, and feel free to join our Discord at:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

Until next time :)[/b]

notes.title: V. 0.8.0 "Corporate Management" is released
notes.content:
Dear Retailers!

The latest update is finally out. 

It has focused heavily in improving the corporate experience, by improving your HQ and all of its functionalities. We have also balanced out some of the gameplay, and changed smaller inconveniences. We hope you will enjoy it ːsteamhappyː

[h1]--- The new HQ ---[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/b23e9d31130b487d1da88933abf06715253f386b.png[/img]

[h3]New design[/h3]
The initial HQ was very barebones, so it has now been completely overhauled. It consists of several floors to run your corporation. The ground floor is for corporation control, and where you manage your new lots, as well as the hiring of managers.

Each concept then has its own unique floor. Here you administer talents, design, as well as interacting with the concept managers.

[h3]New managers[/h3]
You can now hire managers for various jobs. Both for the corporation in general, but also for the individual concepts. So will you spend money on an Area Manager that improves stores run by the Daily Manager, or a Sales Manager that affects the customers in the store you are currently at. But they also require a wage, so think about when it is time to expand.
It takes time for these managers to learn their skill, and become familiar with their new role. They are also influenced by various events happening in the game, so you will need to manage these, and make sure the perfect manager doesn't join another company.

You can also promote a manager from one of your stores to the HQ, and that person will gain a bonus as the employee already has experience with working  at your corporation.

[h3]Company awards[/h3]
At your HQ you can also boast of the achievements earned with your corporation. Show off the Employer of the month, or the Customer Satisfaction Award in your trophy cabinets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d17e551d15251ef8305119db82210ecc8c793608.png[/img]

[h3]No City Hall[/h3]
To allow for this, there will no longer be an office at the CIty Hall, as it will be at the City Map instead.

[h1]--- Balancing and improvements ---[/h1]

[h3][Corporate Fees/h3]
You can now set a corporate fee for each concept, giving some of the store profits back to the HQ, such that it runs more smooth, and you don't need to jump back and transfer funds all the time.

[h3]Price Adjustments[/h3]
It seemed that is was too easy to earn money from computers. So their purchase, and sales prices have been altered to have a smaller profit margin. So in existing games, you might want to adjust the prices.

[h3]Customer AI's[/h3]
Customers now also act differently based on their segment type. The richer persons will demand a higher level of service, and by that ask for help more. Their tendency to ask, is now also based of the article they look at. So they will in general require more help when looking a computers, as compared to clothes.

[h3]Selling to customers[/h3]
The speed of selling to customers has been improved, by shortening the animation time on the conversations. Also a quick sale button has been added, to quickly go through the sales interaction, with varied results off course.

[h3]Deliveries[/h3]
The mailman will now arrive faster at your store, giving you a bit more time to handle articles before you open the store.

[h1]--- Bug Fixes ---[/h1]

First of all, we are terribly sorry for these inconveniences, and of any annoyance they have caused.

[h3]Unloadable Save Games[/h3]
Some of you reported that you could not load some of your entrepreneur save games. This has been corrected, and these games are playable again.

[h3]Summary Screen[/h3]
Some bad design caused this screen to have extremely high loading time in long games, possibly causing a crash, but at best long waiting times when updating the screen. This has been fixed, such that it now updates much faster.

[h3]Loan Bug[/h3]
An issue caused loans to double each time you entered a store, causing then på be unpayable and requiring insane payment amounts. This has been corrected, and loans work again. Also, stores affected by this will be corrected when you enter the store for the first time, reducing the amount of loans to a normal level. 

[b]We hope that you will enjoy these new features, and we would like to hear any comments you might have.

You can also join our discord at:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE[/b]
