notes.title: Letter to our Retailers (2)
notes.content:
Dear Retailers 

We have made some progress during the last week, although a bit slowed, as Tympanix (One of the two devs) has been focusing on his final project at the university.
He is also the one working on the translation system we told about in our last letter.

[h2]The Translation Issue[/h2]
It is no secret that a large portion of the players are German-speaking. This is why this was our test-language (along with Danish which are our native language) to see how difficult it is to manage multiple languages.
We found out that programming and implementing a language was relatively easy (after some cleanup in the code), however all the logistics surrounding it was tough to deal with.

First of all currently the game contains rougly 10.000 words that needs to be translated, which in itself takes quite some time even if you are fluent in the language. 
Secondly, the game continually evolves. This means that between each patch, some words are removed, some are changed and new words are added, meaning that after a couple of weeks a new revision would be needed.
Third of all, the text needs to be understood correctly. So when all these texts are exported, they show up as the pure text only, and nothing more. So the translator might have to translate "Rent" properly. But does this mean the price you pay to rent something, or performing the action of wanting to rent it, which in danish is two very different things.

Having to manage these things for each patch is very time consuming, and is why we in the later patches have resorted to Google Translate. 

Many of you have very kindly offered your help in assisting with the translations in various languages which we are very grateful of. 
However we didn't know how to organize this in a way that makes it easy and efficient. The thought of handling several translators via mail or facebook, having to merge translations into the same document and so on seemed like an excessive workload, which would redice the time spent on developing a lot.

But we still wanted to allow for several languages, so what to do?

[h2]The Community Translation System[/h2]
We evaluated several options online that could assist with this, however they required a (for us) hefty monthly fee. 
So in december we decided to make our own instead, and this is what Tympanix has been spending his time on (along with university) since then. 
The bonus of this program should then be that every player can contribute to the translation of the game. 
Firstly by a webpage that you can log in to using your Steam-account, and secondly within the game itself. 
Here you can search for existing sentences, mark them as wrong, submit your own translation, or vote for an already submitted one.
We can then review these translations make the necessary changes and upload them to the game. This also allows for translations in event more languages.
Hopefully this makes for better translation without it taking up to much time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/162cb894b8b0b09a75ec154c0da9bf25e342bbbc.png[/img]

We expect to have the webpage-solution ready near the end of the month :) 

[h2]Progress since last letter[/h2]
I have then been working on the game itself, making progress with the HQ. I am also happy to say that almost everything has been implemented, with a few things missing.

You now control each concept on each individual floor, on several whiteboards, making it easier to quickly see how it goes. At the ground floor you manage the unassigned buildings, and at the reception you can request the building of an additional floor. As the floors now serve as the concept limit, the allowed number of floors in an area tells how many concepts you can have.
This also means that the first office you rent at the City Hall has been removed. As this also seemed it was a too hard to find, it seemed better to make accessing all HQ's similar and as such they are now all at the city map. 
It has also been connected to the flow of the game, such that applications to the HQ comes and goes, negotiation and renegotiating is possible, as well as swapping managers, and promoting staff from the stores to the HQ.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d66f34a6c18eee075ec0900f8ecd76507362b779.png[/img]

The only thing left, is to make optimism changes of your managers, based off the events in your corporation, such that you actively need to manage the personnel at your HQ.

[h2]The bug list[/h2]
This week also made us aware of some new bugs. The loan system is relatively new, and we know there are somme issues with games having been created at a time of the old system, and is played in the new one. 
However this concealed another issue, doubling loans each time a store is loaded, making the game contain more loans than the 3 there are showed, eventually requiring an insane amount of repayment funds.
These should be taken care of in the update, along with fixing the savegames themselves.

We have also fixed an issue of stores not being sold correctly, and other issues reported to us here at steam.

Please let us know of other bugs you might find, as the period leading up to the release of the next update will focus on playtesting and bug removal.

Happy sales out there :)
//Dohlar

notes.title: Letter for our Retailers
notes.content:
Dear Retailers

We would like to wish you a happy new year, thank you for a great 2019. 
Since our last update in December we decided to slow it down a bit, as December is always a busy month.

But now we have reached January, and daily life is back to normal, but with a whole new set of ideas to try out, this being one of them. We have always wanted to keep you informed of what is happening at our side of the screens, but we have not been consistent in doing so.

Therefore we will start making a regular newsletter here on Steam to tell you what we are working on, along with other things of interest, and let you know that the game hasn't gone quiet. This will also allow you to give feedback to our ideas, and perhape make them even better even before we are finished making them. 

So as always, don't hold back with any comments you might have :) 

[h1]Since the last update[/h1]
Although we have had a busy december, we haven't been idle at all.

We have 2 projects we are working on simultaneously.

[h3]HQ improvements[/h3]
Since we released the Corporation Mode, we have been focusing on making this a more stable experience by removing bugs, and unintuitive implementations. As the bug reports went down, it was time to carry on with the improvements. We know that the bugs are still out there, so please, PLEASE let us know of the ones you find :-)

At the release of the Corporation Mode, your HQ only had the bare necesseties for playing the game. As we want this to be a more focal part of running your corporation, we wanted to improve this area.

The main floor is dedicated for control of the corporation itself, with each of your concepts occupying an entire floor of it's own. 
This will allow for more control and more possibilities, as these areas gets filled out with content. So hopefully it will make more sense to why you must expand your HQ to allow for more concepts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a7004f29c837beb19025379ec2bfd741828df1e1.png[/img]

The first thing we have started out with, was implementing various corporate managers. So each concept now has space for 3 managers. 

An Area Manager, which affect the stores that are run by daily managers.
A Sales Manager, which affects your staff, your customers, and new stores.
A Marketing Manager, which affects the traffic into your store.

Then the corporation itself will have 2 managers.

A Financial Manager, which affects rents, loans and owned property handling.
A Corporation Manager, which affects all of the above mentioned managers.

This should mimic the structure of a larger corporation with a hieracy of leadership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/c8cb88176e832ff87982d3c191e042b0ee9e21ca.png[/img]

For aquiring these managers, there will be an interview process like when hiring staff, where you can interview the person for a certain role. You can then appoint an interviewed person for that role, or move one of your other managers. 
It will also be possible to have one of your staff in your stores to send an application to your HQ. In this way it will be possible to take your rookie employee all the way to the top, to become manager for the entire Corporation.

Each manager has to familiarize themself with your corporation, and with their role before they can use their abilitiesto the fullest. So this erquires you to make a decision. 
- Hire a person from the outside, who has to spend more time familiarizing. 
- Take another manager, who only need to learn the new role, but leaves another role unmanned.
- Promote one from your store, who might need a replacement, but is very familiar with the ways of the corporation.

All of the will be handled from your manager's office in the ground floor.

To interact with the managers themselves, you will need to go to their office and do your business. That being spend their talent points, offering them a raise, or taking the dreaded talk of letting them go. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f0cf6601d9fe9760c65bab4da2a94818b7e06026.png[/img]

All of the above is already implemented into the game.

The next thing to do is to influence their optimism, such that you also need to keep them satisfied, and to implement their actual skills into the game. After that CorpManagers v 1.0 is ready, and the next update will be released.

In our next letter we will tell about our other project, which is the community translator tool, with which you can help improve, or create new translations in the game.

Until next time :-)

notes.content:
[b]Dear Retailers

We are very exited to finally announce that update 0.7.0 is here!
And it features two new large improvements to the game.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e45bdc41abd6546ede96047ae333afe5af9eb5e7.png[/img]

[b][h1]---- New languages ----[/h1][/b]
First of all, the game is now playable in two new languages: German and Danish.
This is for testing out, and if the feedback is positive, we might expand to more languages in the future.



[b][h1]---- Corporation Mode ----[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/11c38c6e76a2992f528b819ab20f8b6d6603eb05.png[/img]

[b]We have been working very hard to bring the complete new game mode to you:
The Corporation Mode, but what did it end up with?
Well, here you start off with no money, and must create the largest corporation in the city. And to do that, it will require a lot of hard work:[/b]

[h1]Contract Work:[/h1]
To earn your first money, you must work for some of the other retailers in the city. Earn reputation with these companies, and land more lucrative deals.

[h1]PopUp Stores:[/h1]
Some companies opens PopUp stores in the city. A store that is open for 10 days. The sales from these stores are saved, so see if you can beat your on record when the chance arrives the next time around.

When you have enough money, it is time for you to start your own company.

[h1]City Hall:[/h1]
To do this, you must go to the city hall. Set up your company, and get your first office space.
In the City Hall you can also get advice on how to deal with starting a new company.

[h1]HQ:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/5a6e2ee2baff16374443fe206af4f1a17c152a58.png[/img]

Your small cubicle will probably be your first HQ for your company. In time you will be able to buy your own building, and establish a larger headquarter. Your HQ decides how many stores and concepts you can have.
(Currently the HQ is very basic, but it will be expanded in future patches, and have more functionalities)

[h1]Concepts:[/h1]
In your HQ you can setup your various concepts. Concepts are the brands that your stores will belong to. So one concept might be of fashion clothing, and another of electronics. A good concept takes time to build. You can assign multiple stores to one concept, and build several chains of stores. The stores then work together, improving your concept faster.

If you are a success, and get to own several stores, you will need help. [b]So can you balance out all of these things and become the King of Retail?[/b]



[b][h1]---- Other New Stuff ----[/h1][/b]
[h1]Staff Wages:[/h1]
Your staff will now require new wage negotiations if their skills doesn't match the wage, or if they have been working for you for some time. To assist with this, we improved the negotiation flow to make it a bit more intuitive.

[h1]Staff Requests:[/h1]
Other than wages, the staff will also let you know of other requests they have, such as the desire for taking a new course, or having a day off. How you respond is up to you, but don't promise something that you can't keep. We also added some other events for you to react to.

[h1]Staff Personalities:[/h1]
You staff also have various personality traits. So the sales person you need, loses energy faster, but is very light-hearted. Will you hire this person, or find another.



We would very much like to hear comments and feedback regarding all of these new things here on the forums.
Also feedback regarding bugs, and things you think should be balanced are also more than welcome.

notes.title: Progress on corporation mode
notes.content:
Dear Retailers
It is time to give you some info on what will be by far the largest update from us so far.

[b][h1]So what is corporation mode?[/h1][/b]
In corporation mode you start off in a new city with no money in your pocket, and no reputation at all.

[h1]The Career Part[/h1]
To get some money you will have to sign contracts with other companies to run their stores. These contracts will give you a daily wage, and also a bonus when completing the task at hand.

As you complete more jobs, your personal reputation with these companies will increase, allowing you to take contracts in better locations for higher wages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3f00f6d6dbb9171ff392a4c4c56c71a7a3a35ab2.png[/img]

[h1]Starting your corporation[/h1]
When you have enough money, you can head to the city hall, and start your corporation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9c035d7c6e74e4091ab56b38d4df7744235c2cf5.png[/img]

Your corporation will be the center of it all. This is the "master" company which holds it all together.

A corporation will also need it's headquarters, but being completely new you might have to settle for renting an office space in the city hall.

[h1]...and make your first concept.[/h1]
With your headquarters ready, you can make your first concept.

A concept is a unique brand, with it's own identity and targeting specific markets. So the concept is what your customers will see, and eventually come to know. However each concept starts small. You will need to develop it over time, to gradually expand it's reputation to the customers. Will you focus on becoming the expert in one category, or becoming adequate in several.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/989f96de37b5ef757a7a18cfd022d4b820756989.png[/img]

Depending on your HQ, your corporation can own lots of concepts. As each concept gets larger, it will require more management. So each concept will need various managers in the HQ to reach it's full potential. This being a sales managers, purchasing managers, and area managers among others.

[h1]Putting the concepts to use[/h1]
Your concepts will of course need stores to be of use. So you have to find the lots you wish to place stores on. They will vary greatly in population and segment composition. So the celebrities might be nearer the stores at the beach, and the farmers near the rural areas. Off course the more attractive locations cost more. 
You can both rent and buy the lots around the city, with buying off course being the more expensive choice. However buying a lot allows you to build on it, expanding the store, whereas with a rental you will have to make do with what is.

When you have decided on a lot, you assign a concept to the store which is going to be built there, invest some of your hard earned money in it and then start playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/0c880a6ef844fd33cf29945dd7cbd4b65c7158e1.png[/img]

When playing inside the store, the game works at you know it. However customers also now look at the reputations of your concept when deciding if they want to shop at your store. 

[h1]Multi-store owner[/h1]
When you have the money to expand, it is time to prepare for your next store. Before leaving, it is best that you hire a daily manager to your current store. This person will take care of your store while you are away at another. While at a store, the other stores will still earn (or cost) you money, and contribute to your concepts. From time to time you will have to check in at the store, to make sure that everything is running smoothly, or extend your stay to improve it further.

[h1]Big spender[/h1]
When everything is on track, you will need to expand you HQ to allow for more concepts, and more stores. And hopefully you will get the big skyscraper, crush the competing stores and dominate the city.




[u][h1][b]Some notes on the develpoment[/b][/h1][/u]
[h1]It has taken some time[/h1]
We wanted to explaing why you havent received any updates from us in a while.

As we are only two persons making this game, and this being our first, things take time, and we still have a lot of learning to do.
So making an update of this size by basically creating a new game on top of the existing is quite a mountainclimb for us, both in planning and executing. 
As we have learned on the way we are also beginnig to see that some of our earlier practices could have been done in a much better way. 
But as these practices has been used on the foundations of the game, we also have to spend some time "untangling" and improving this, to allow us to be faster and more efficient in the future.

So these are the main reasons of why this takes some time. But rest assured, we are and have been working hard every week to bring the content to you.

[h1]Why such a big update now[/h1]
When we decided to make this, we weren't quite sure of how long it would take. However we felt that this was necessary to improve your experience. 

Lots of you had already maxed out the game, and requested bigger stores. Increasing the sizes would only fix it for a small amount of time, as this would just be "more of the same". This also meant that our time was used making these hotfixes instead of progressing the game to where we plan it to go. And since you always would use up this content before we could add something new, we decided to go another direction.

So this is to give you a new experience, and a new challenge that went beyond of "just getting a big store", which hopefully will keep you entertained for longer. And when this is done, we will go back to improve the core game and adding more articles.

[h1]How long left[/h1]
All of the core elements has been made, and we are now beginning to merge them together. When this is done, we start on adding some more content. 
The city map only consist of the small area, which will have to be expanded. 
The career part only contain the "mandatory" stores, and needs some more possibilities. 
The HQ can not be expanded to unlock more concepts.
The city hall allows you to talk to NPC's, which work as a part of the tutorial, which also needs some work.
Upon adding this, a bugfixing and balancing period starts, and when that is done, we are ready to release it to you.

So a very rough, and unpromised, estimate is 3-4 weeks of time.

We hope that this answers some of the questions you might have, ans you are as aways more than welcome to comment and bring ideas to the game  :)

notes.title: Work In Progress
notes.content:
We have received several messages from you asking about how far the updates are coming.
And it has been quite some time since our last post, so here comes :-)

We are still working on a larger change to the game, allowing you to expand your business into opening several stores. We have almost gotten the basics to work, and after that we need to add some content giving it some playability. When this is done, it is about testing, bugfixing and balancing. It will most likely not be fully complete for the update, but will be accessible as a beta-version alowing you to play and give feedback on what you think of it.

So what have we made so far?


[h1][b]City Map[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d33404bd95f0b6f3d65cab1a5d62577895a165ea.png[/img]
First of all, there is the City Map. This will show the available lots for rent, for purchase, or contract offers allowing you to earn some money working for other companies.
The image shown is the only area at the moment, but will be expanded to a larger map of different population compositions and densities. Since these areas differ in customers, it will require you to pay more attention to which articles you purchase, and how you manage the area. 
This means you also can't afford the best of locations immediately, but you will have to earn money the lower populated areas before being able to open a store in the midtown.


[h1][b]New Areas[/b][/h1]
There will also be other areas to explore, and people to interact with. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7007451d09e7ecb939ca44fb816060aedc1d13e2.png[/img]
For instance the University which in time will contain much improved tutorials, and tips on how to play the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/6bb919e4010442ff730bf95bde0d6d5a8967423e.png[/img]
Or the city hall, where you must apply for new companies, or buying lots to build on.

These areas are only very basic at the moment, but will also improve in the future, along with new ones.



[h1][b]Personalities[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/4ceae5beaa08d6407559a047fc72420429b030d3.png[/img]
Your staff now has received different personality traits. This means that they now have two positives and two negatives to them, meaning that you also need to take this into consideration when managing and hiring.


[h1][b]Wages & Negotiation[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/345f9454584628673356dba79474459a26076fe4.png[/img]
The staff are also now aware about being better at working at your store. So they will demand higher wages as time goes by. This also means that you can call up your staff for renegotiations, and even promotions to become the manager when you are away.



So this is what we have been up to for the last month. We don't know yet when it will be available for playing, but hopefully we have cleared the worst parts of the work. If this gives you any fun ideas on what could be possible to do in the game, please let us know about it.

Happy Retailing
//The Devs

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/a1eace62467d2763014e0955d6c1b8b2a6680455.png[/img]

Dear Retailers

[b]A month has gone by since our last release, and we have now finished work on this one. So what does it contain?
[/b]

[b][h1]New Articles[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/43acef0d51d1d13df68cca299866cd39fc3a3219.png[/img]

- Some of the shirts have been updated to better looking models. 
- Several shoes has been added, and some replaced (There will be added more shoes over time, also replacing older models).
- A new category "Pants" has been added, containing a lot of these to sell.


[b][h1]Close for a day[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/9295300188721847b89f71c130291d3410fa9916.png[/img]

It is now possible to keep closed for an entire day, allowing you to do whatever you feel like for an entire day. In the next patch there will also be an opportunity to request special deliveries, allowing you to order articles on this day also to give what you might need.


[b][h1]Better ordering[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/ce4f56cc548d0235c0db828d8ebcd31fbbf57de9.png[/img]

Ordering has received some upgrades. You can browse your previous orders, and also reorder what has been sold the same day. This should make it easier to manage the stock.


[b][h1]New storage items[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/77e3afe69a71e914e84f297215cf3af123dbf0a3.png[/img]

The storage has received several units to choose from. Both to store your articles, and to receive deliveries on. This unfortunately means that the old units has been removed, impacting save games. However these will be refunded, and you will not lose any articles that was saved on thee units.


[b][h1]Balancing[/h1][/b]
It was getting too easy earning lots of money from day 1, so we have adjusted the game in several areas.

[b]Reputation gains:[/b]
It didn't take many days to receive full reputation in all areas. So the gains have been downscaled a bit for categories, and quite a lot for customer segments. So now you have to fight more in the beginnings to get customers into the store, using catalogues, forum posts and fetching them from the streets.

[b]Reputation losses:[/b]
The penalty for having customers leaving the store was basically so small that it didn't have any effect. This penalty has been increased such that these customers has an influence. So try and keep them all happy :) 

[b]Article saturations:[/b]
It was possible to keep selling the same few articles over and over again each day. This is still possible, but now the customers will be less willing to buy these articles. So for maximum sale, it is needed to keep a large variety of articles, or to change out the assortment once in a while.


[b][h1]Other minor features[/h1][/b]
[b]- Staff on registers going on break.[/b]
It was quite annoying when staff went to break, if they manned the only register. Now, if they are the only one on register, they will allow the register open and just go on break. If there are others with an open register, they will finish their queue, and then head for break.

[b]- Staff are better at restocking[/b]
Staff didn't always fill out a display if a location wasn't completely empty. This has also been adjusted, and they should now be better at restocking.

[b]- Staff can help with cleanup of boxes[/b]
If there are boxes with articles on the ground, the staff can now also help unpack those, if they have unlocked the talent for it off course.

[b]- Improvement of space requirements[/b]
All inventory have had their space requirements updated, so there should not be any more annoying overlappings "cheating" you of valuable space.

[b]- Even better AI movement[/b]
The AI movement have been adjusted further, and should allow for even better moving among each other.


[b][h1]Bugs and bugs[/h1][/b]
As always many bugs has been removed, and new ones has most certainly entered. So we still need all of your help and feedback in spotting more of these when you encounter them :-) 


[b]And we are still very interested in listening to anything you might have to say of what is good, what can be better, and all your great ideas. We are especially interested in listening to what you feel the game need work on, if it's more articles, new features, balancing or something else.

We hope you enjoy our work
\\ The Devs[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 is out
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear retailers: Update 0.5.0 is out.[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/33f20d7a4f56cc7620956c191afdf098a835c2eb.png[/img]
[h1]New category: Computers[/h1]
We listen to what you want - More items to sell.
The addition of computers seemed like a straightforward thing to do. So this is a new category, with corresponding new new displays.
These articles are more expensive, both when buying and selling and are of a higher luxury. 
This means that the customers are pickier, and needs an overall better sales efforts before they purchase.

[h1]Events, calendar and mails[/h1]
The city has to be more dynamic. So various events will occur once in a while. For instance a discount from a certain supplier or an increase in a population segment.
You can see various events on your new Calendar. This is accessible through the HUD menu in store, or from the newly placed calendar near the door in your office.
When an event occurs, you are notified via mail on your computer. Your staff now also mails you about various events like sickness or resignations.
This system is just finished, so you can expect lots of events to be added in the future.

[h1]Bankruptcy[/h1]
Yes. Due to the arrival of the event system, it is now possible to go bankrupt. So no more owing the bank millions of (insert currency here), 
but instead you have a certain amount of days to fix the situation before the store gets closed.

[h1]Improved AI movement[/h1]
The AI had a tendency to clump and walk in the way of each other, causing some undesirable behavior and following frustration.
This has been adjusted allowing for a much better flow even when crowded. In crowded situations they still "wiggle" about, but manage to pass each other and reach their destination. 
We hope this will improve the experience in bigger stores. 

[h1]News[/h1]
We wanted to be able to communicate with the players more directly, so a news feed has been implemented at the main menu screen. Here we will post about what is coming, tips to things we see players struggle with and other notifications.

[h1]More bugs[/h1]
We are receiving a lot of bug reports, and thank you very much for those.
We have removed a fair share of them (but others are bound to have arrived). Please continue to post any difficulties or bad experiences you might have, and we will try to solve them.



[u][h1][b]Up next[/b][/h1][/u]
It is summer and 50 % of the team is going for a well earned vacation, and the other half of the team (me) will stay home and continue working.

[h1]Currency selector[/h1]
We see people get confused about the prices, which makes perfectly sense. At the moment the game uses an unspecified currency, with values based on the unknown Danish Krone which makes no sense to 99.9 of the earths population.
So we will make a currency designer where you can select various currencies, or create your own. This should make the game more familiar to all of you.

[h1]User Preferences[/h1]
There has also been requests for various minor implementations. So we will create an overdue preferences menu for you to customize your experience. This will off course grow over time, so feel free to let us know what you think this screen should contain.

[h1]Next Category[/h1]
Since we have the clothes / shoes pair. It should also be possible to sell minor computer accessories. So we will begin making monitors, keyboards, mice and what else we might think off.

[h1]Languages[/h1]
There has been an increasing demand to translate the game into different languages, and we will therefore begin working on this. However as this is totally new to us we don't know how long this will take to do.

[h1]City mode[/h1]
We have a dream of making a 3D city overview that contains the game instead of menus. This should contain entrepreneur and career mode combined, along with opening chains of stores that work together. 
This city view should also contain a corporate HQ, supplier expos, tutorial school and what else we might put in there. This should make for a more complete gaming experience, making it feel like building an empire, and creating a more diverse and challenging gameplay. 
So this will be our next major project that we will begin working on.

[u][h1][b]We hope you enjoy the changes and, as always, if you have ideas, found bugs, or any other feedback don't hesitate to let us know.[/b][/h1][/u]

notes.content:

[b]Finally, it's out ːsteamhappyː

First of all, a GREAT thanks to all of you who are playing our game. We have been very overwhelmed of the interest it has received. The amount of playtime we see is more than what we could have hoped for. 
We also received the attention of several youtubers playing our game with, these 3 creating rougly 2 million views combined.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zSelrrOMs1g&t=7s

But after a long developing period to this patch has finally come to an end.
We have managed to put a lot into it, including accomodating a few community requests. We are sorry we passed the promised deadline for all of you waiting for the update. We hope you can forgive us :-) [/b]

[h1][u][b]So what did it end up with?[/b][/u][/h1]
[h1]City changes[/h1]
As mentioned earlier, the way the city functions has changed. Customers are divided into segments, each having distinct traits. So you now also need to gain reputation with these segments, along with reputation for the categories that you sell.

[h1]Staff updates[/h1]
As mentioned a big part was building talent trees for your staff. This means staff develop in the way you desire for them. They might be experienced in a role upon hiring, bringing additional bonuses to that task. They might be inexperienced in others meaning negative actions might occur while learning that part. Some they can not even perform before having taken the appropriate course to learn. 
Although not changed dramatically, a few changes has been made to the interviewing part to accomodate these changes, and in preparation for future features.

[h1]Customer interactions[/h1]
There was a lot of feedback coming from you, indication the desire for a change to the way of interacting with customers.
So we prioritized this. 
Instead of being a hit or miss system, you can now interact with the customers in a more direct way. Try to boost a need, or create a desire for a specific article. Quickly jump from customer to customer in a busy hour and help them all a bit, or spend your time with one, trying to build up the big sale. You decide completely.
In the dull hours, you can stand outside, and pull in some of the pedestrians walking by the store.

[h1]Magazine designer[/h1]
At the office it is now possible to create advertisment spreads to feature in the city's magazines. Select the magazine, the size, the featured ads and publish it. It will provide a boost to your reputation, along with a boost to certain customer segments walking by your store.

[h1]Forum posts[/h1]
You can also build reputation by creating posts at the community forums. Choose the parameters of the post, and watch it gain momentum with views and comments.
[b]This feature is still in the early stages, as we would like to gain inputs from you on how to proceed with this feature. So it will be improved upon in the future.[/b] 

[h1]Others[/h1]
A lot of bugs has been fixed (and others most likely arrived). 
The time of performing various actions has been adjusted, along with customer waiting times. 
Customers are now a bit more expressive during their shopping experience. While we have had no focus on adding graphics content, the main menu world have been changed along with other minor graphical changes.

[h1]Saves[/h1]
Due to the previous setup [u][b]your saves will be deleted from the game[/b][/u]. We are sorry for this inconvenience of losing all of your magnificent store out there, however we have been cought a bit off guard on managins several versions (As this is our first game, we are still learning a lot all the time).
We will try and restructure things in the future to accomodate different version compatibility, but will not yet promise that it won't happen again in the future, due to this restructuring. We know it sucks, but we might as well be up front about it.

[h1][u][b]What's next[/b][/u][/h1]
[h1]More content[/h1]
Since the majority of the feedback requested more items, we will spend a fair amount of time from now on adding more content into the game. This means, among other things, that we will focus on adding more articles, more inventory, more categories, more career mode possibilities, and more of other  forms content we can create.

[h1]Shorter development periods[/h1]
Due to the duration of this patch, the next couple of patches will be aimed to have a considerably shorter development time. So along with the adding content, we will try not to make so many big implementations at the same time.

[h1]Feedback is VERY welcome[/h1]
Due to the changes of this patch, there are bound to be bugs we have missed. 
We are also, as always, interested in your opinions, ideas, experiences and cool stories you might have regarding the game. We are interested to know if there are any balancing issues, so we can get it adjusted.
So please, PLEASE, feel free to let us know about it. We encourage you to use the discussion board here on Steam as we regularly check in to see what you have written, and are very interested to talk about what direction the game should take.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
As of now we have not decided 100 % on what the next patch should contain, other than the addition of content. So regarding the topic above, you can have a great influence on what will come next. 
We off course have a million ideas on things we want to do, so our task is to organize the next part of the development. And with that, we will try to make a road map, so all of you can see what our thought on the game is, and what you might expect in the future.


That escalated to a lot of reading ːsteamhappyː
We hope you enjoy the new additions, and again we are very interested in antyhing you might have to say about them.

Kind regards

The King of Retail dev team.

notes.title: Coming up at the final stretch
notes.content:
Time for a little update again :-)

We are close to finishing the content of this update, and will begin bugfixing and balancing. But what have we been up to?

[h1]The population][/h1]
The city demographics has changed. So from being a city made of two values (wealth, and fashion sense) it now consist of various population groups, each with their own desires. Each segment have their own population and shopping patterns, so changing your opening hours might change the type of customers that enters the store. This also mean that you will need to gain reputation with each segment. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/cf9eb22ee2fdc653ea52bd2e30f71036c740bbd4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/5724cfcbe99e70e29d6a7c39d8d3915ebeca3d9e.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Customer interaction[/h1]
Speaking of customers.
A lot of feedback have indicated the desire for a new customer interaction system. So we have made just that.
Increase a customers need for a specific category, or try to create a desire for a certain article. 
Play the long game and spend a lot of time with one customer who then might go shopping crazy, or try and reach them all and increase the overall average sale. 
If the store is completely empty, it is now also possible to go outside the store to try and convince people passing by to enter.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/33a2eb5d18397ee5b406a563c8b90852c7b4827b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/7ba82d0911c874168028279c7137e35b526531a0.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/c872d41678bc9ac90b00ab089f5d0aa33931a887.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/8f2cb40717c0119350defb0b11427f650183ef50.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Staff talents[/h1]
Away with the skills and in with talents. Your staff now need to learn how to perform various tasks. At first they are unsecure and make errors at new tasks, but will in time be very proficient and have special perks to their jobs. However they will ned to attend a course from time to time to unlock their true potential. So ask the right questions at the interview, or you might the the wrong employee, as they will not be able to perform all tasks from day one.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/79d8fce974c883fdd8fb4cf84d40e83faf18b13e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/05880fe13f052a010565f936477a4cdeaed88b39.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Marketing[/h1]
Since there are a lot more reputation to uncover, you need some tools to do that. But fear not, the marketing functions has expanded.

In the store, it is now possible to make forum posts at your computer. Target an audience, make some posts, and watch them grow with views and comments, as they generate reputation.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/8d504101caae4f5331e5fd8ef2de7ebef46498f4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/511fe7a687090dca92fa59b2b3af6f043ed8b8ad.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/279f7e382248b06dc8e6933c272f51be983cf23b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/4b1ea73f0711a81e14071ad2ff26f4c00322dd61.png[/img][/url]

In your office you can plan out bigger campaigns with the catalogue designer. Select the size, the magazine, drag your desired ads onto the pages and customize your campaign to your needs. Attract more customers, increase the desire for categories, or become more known at a certain segment. Do one or do them all, the choice is yours.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/32fadf68521fbd0db2be90866422f47c4c3c65b3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/9d7f52f81d6bf04756b27acddcdc990fefbb7d44.png[/img][/url]

Take care ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: So what's happening?
notes.content:
It has been about 3 weeks since our last post so we wanted to fill you in on how the time has been spent.

But first of all, a big thank you for playing our game. It means a lot to us that so many people enjoys playing it, and sees the potential of what the game can become. So please keep all your feedback with bugs, good ideas and plain thoughts coming. We take note of them all, and quite a few of them has already made it to our "To-do" list.

But what about the game?

Well, the city itself has been changed. 
Instead of it being a city of a fixed size, wealth & fashion, it is now divided into several customer segments. This will, in future implementations, give a more dynamic city, as these populations can change over time. 
For instance. A new university opens up nearby, increasing Teen population by 20.000. This also allowed a change to the flow of the city. Farmers might be early shoppers, where Techies instead comes primarily in the afternoon. And since you also need to obtain reputation with these groups, your decisions means a lot more for your sales.

Next up is staff talents. Instead of the passive, quite boring Skill Level System, we have introduced Staff Talents. Each staff still earns experience from the tasks they perform. But now as they become better, you can select individual perks for them. Every once in a while you will have to send them on a course to help their learning and unlock even better perks. The job interview will also receive an overhaul, changing a lot of it. Staff planning will as a result now require more attention. This also plays perfectly into one of the future upgrades with Personalities and Personality Traits.

Aaaaand... the marketing. The current version is a very sad part, as this was introduced just before the Early Access launch, making you able to do something about your reputation. You can now make Forum Posts for the low end reputations on your computer. Select your targets, define the parameters, and watch how many views and comments they receive. For the higher reputations it will be possible to build and manage a website. Build it up, attract a following, and let that following build you higher reputations and bigger effect on your advertisements. 
Advertisements is in turn something you make at your office. Create your own flyers or magazines. Focus on an article to build up a hype, a customer group to temporarily increase population, or a category to increase the overall needs. The choice is yours.

Finally, customer interactions. 
We have received a lot of feedback criticizing the way you interact with the customers, in which we agree. Instead the new system will be more decision based. Will you spend your time with one customer, going for the big sale, or a little with everyone to make them all happy. Will you approach them aggressively or more casual? The right decisions will improve your sales, while the wrong ones will make your customer leave in fury hurting your reputation. We also hope to make several sales scenarios based on how far the customer is in their shopping sequence.

So the above is already done, about to be done, or planned out. We will see if we get time for some more before the testing and bug hunting period begins. We aim to release this upgrade in middle/late May. Since we all have exam periods coming up, we VERY unwillingly also have to spend some time doing that. 

So we hope you will find the changes interesting, and comments or ideas to the above are also very welcome.

- The King of Retail dev team -

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 is out!
notes.content:
Fellow retailers,

It's been a little more than a week since King of Retail launched on Early Access and what a week it was! We are overwhelmed by your interest, engagement and support for our game and we wish to thank you all. Your posts on the discussion boards and feedback from the in-game menu has helped us greatly in catching bugs and given us plenty of ideas for future content. It has definitely sparked our motivation to improve the game even further!

We would also like to thank the YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzEy7pi3B7TIS9cn_sdKK9A]GrayStillPlays[/url] for making a very entertaining video about King of Retail and if you haven't seen his video/channel yet we can't recommend it enough!

Now onto the patch contents! We decided to collect your very helpful bug reports/feedback and weed out all the bugs we could this week. So here's a change list:

[h1]v0.3.1 changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] All audio settings will now be saved/loaded between game sessions
[*] Added separate channels for Ambience and Door Bell sounds in the Audio Settings
[*] Fixed the sound played when you win a level in career mode to be part of the Sound Effects group so it no longer causes increased heart rate and your ears to bleed
[*] The mailman will no longer get stuck and review his life choices while delivering articles
[*] Fixed an issue where the career offers would get duplicated in the main menu
[*] The career level where you have to break even in 5 days will now show a prompt when you fail the contract, despite the realism being stuck in a failing business
[*] AI's will no longer get stuck (behind the scenes) after spawning and affecting performance
[*] When loading a game the jukebox will now start playing again
[*] Reworked the animation system for characters and added new animations #CantHaveEnoughAnimations
[*] Added some new hair styles and face types
[*] Fixed an issue with the registers and staff not being able to access them due to lacking space between the wall and the register
[*] Staff can no longer use "the force" to interact with objects that are being moved by the manager
[*] The game will no longer implode on itself when adding/removing articles from a display simultaneously
[*] Inventory packed in boxes will no longer deduct funds when moving/placing the box
[*] Fixed a glitch in the matrix where the marketing PC would sometimes spawn inside a wall
[*] Added the marketing PC to the "Getting Started" checklist when starting a new store
[*] Unemployment rate suddenly spiked: Job applications will now always appear in your office
[*] You can no longer negotiate with multiple people at the same time
[*] While in your office, pressing ESC will now zoom out of any interaction
[*] Fixed a visual bug where only half the screen would be blurry when pausing a game (opening Settings menu)
[*] Pallets now require a larger space around them to be placed to avoid navigation for AI's to be blocked (might affect existing save games, but will fix itself when placed again)
[*] Fixed some of our broken English throughout the game ;) 
[/list]

Thank you all for helping us track down most of these bugs! As for the future we will begin focusing on adding three new mechanics to the game namely a talent tree for you staff, replacing the customer interaction system with a new and improved design and adding new ways to do marketing for you stores. When we are a bit further in our design of these we might show and tell a bit ;) 
Don't forget to visit our [url=https://www.facebook.com/kingofretail/]Facebook Page[/url] for announcements, competitions and more!

We wish you all a great weekend and good luck in your sales!
-The dev team

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Dear retailers,
we are very excited and happy to announce that King of Retail is now officially out on Early Access!

First and foremost we would like to extend thanks to all of our beta-testers, your testing and feedback has helped tremendously in catching those pesky bugs and we hope you will lend us your continued support going forward.

With that said we are very interested in your thoughts and ideas about the game. Are you ready to start as a brand new manager and challenge yourself by completing various contracts in the career mode? Or perhaps you are more into being your own boss and set your own goals in the entrepreneur mode? Feel free to share your thoughts on the King of Retail Community Hub or from the in-game feature, we'll be sure to check in and listen!

As for the future we are already in the process of designing and developing the next features for the game and we would like to give you a heads up on what that is:

[h1]Talent tree for you manager[/h1]
Becoming the next King of Retail is not a simple task but instead a long and challening process. There are a lot of different aspects in retail: handling sales, ordering stock and managing staff to name a few. And no matter how good you are you can not become the ultimate expert in each aspect. We would like to introduce a talent tree for the manager where you, as a player, will have the ability to choose which aspects you'd like to pursue and become an expert in.

[h1]No marketing, no profit![/h1]
Building and setting up a store is no small task but all your efforts might go to waste if no one even knows you exist. That is why marketing is vital for success! We'd like to expand on the current marketing aspect in the game with more ways to build up your reputation and get those customers inside the store. But marketing can come in many forms, such as online campaigns, catalogues, ads or even shouting at pedestrians on the street! We are currently working out which methods would fit the game best so more on this later.

[h1]Customer interaction[/h1]
The current implementation of how you interact with the customers when they ask for help is admittely a mechanic from the game's early days and we feel this needs a rework! Interacting with customers is your chance as a manager to directly affect the sales. As with much in retail, this comes with a risk! Being too pushy might end in the customer being annoyed and leave your store without making a purchase. But with the right pitch and sweet talk you could convince the customer to buy more than intended, earning you a boost in sales! We would like to capture this risk-reward aspect into to a simple interaction where you would make a choice: Do I take the safe route to guarantee a sale or do I push extra hard to influence the customer in spending more money than intended?


There is still a long road ahead of us and we hope the three points above help steer the game in the right direction. Again we are very eager to hear what you think about King of Retail, be it good or bad we will take both into consideration!

We wish you luck on your way to becoming the next King of Retail!

-The King of Retail dev team

notes.title: Beta v0.3.0 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]King of Retail is here with a new content patch v0.3.0![/h1]

We've been working hard to bring you this patch which will be the version to be released on Early Access as soon as possible! Here's a list of the most important changes:

[b]- New game mode - Career![/b]
Managers can now begin their career in retail with this new game mode! The career is laid out as various contracts that present different scenarios/challenges in the retail world. Each manager you create now has his/her own resume that will be filled as contracts are accepted and completed giving the player an overview of the progress made.

[b]- Articles rework![/b]
How all articles are presented in the game has been reworked. Instead of articles having variations in the form of different colors, each variant is now its very own article. This saves the player a lot of clicks in menus when playing the game and gives a better overview of all the articles in general. In addition new articles have also been added to game.

[b]- Marketing![/b]
It's now possible to buy and place a new computer for your staff room in the store! Here you can do marketing research slowly increasing the reputation of your store ultimately attracting more and more customers. You can also have your staff do this research while you buzz around doing important manager business!

[b]- Overall updates, balancing and bug fixes![/b]
In general some older systems/mechanics have been updated/optimized to make the game perform better overall and ease development in the future. Some menus has also been given an overhaul and lots of bugs have been squashed!

This version is planned to be released on Early Access very soon so stay tuned for more information!

- The King of Retail team
